sources.title: rig usage command
sources.locator: packages/cli/src/commands/usage.ts lines 1-6 and 40-75 (CostPayload, Pi cost line, providerChargeText)
sources.finding: rig usage serves tokens per hour, window velocities and an explicit unknown rail from the daemon usage routes; rig usage cost prints Pi seats a model-priced estimate from persisted entries with what is excluded named, shows OpenRouter charge beside (never summed with) the estimate, prints tiny amounts as <$0.01 not $0.00, and says not reported when absent.

sources.title: Usage series projection
sources.locator: packages/daemon/src/domain/usage-series.ts lines 1-24 (lanes context and provider_window, honesty rails)
sources.finding: Over-time usage query over usage_samples with lanes context and provider_window (provider usage-window percentages), counted resets, no negative burn, and an explicit unknown entry with reason instead of a fabricated zero; no account field is served.

sources.title: Watchdog scheduler
sources.finding: One in-flight tick at a time; a slow tick delays the next and overlapping ticks are not queued; stop awaits the in-flight tick.

sources.title: Watchdog policy engine
sources.finding: Built-in watchdog policies: artifact-pool-ready, edge-artifact-required, periodic-reminder and context-usage-threshold.

sources.title: Web UI shell
sources.finding: Web UI layout code has a mobile rail that collapses into a top-bar menu, iOS-minimum tap targets (line 291) and a phone-first single-column slice review; a viewport hook switches layouts at an iPad-portrait breakpoint.

sources.title: Workflow acceptance options
